{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Vegetarian cuisine|Vegetarian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

==Ingredients==

* 1 [[Cookbook:Egg White|egg white]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] cold [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
* ½ tsp flavoring

==Procedure==

# Put the egg white, sugar, and water in the top of a [[Cookbook:Double Boiler|double boiler]].
# Place over [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiling]] water and [[Cookbook:Beat|beat]] with a [[Cookbook:Beater|rotary egg beater]] seven minutes.
# Then add baking powder and flavoring.
# Remove from heat and beat until thick.
# Spread in swirls over cake.
